summary: The UserReportFilters class is responsible for updating and searching user-specific report filters within the HSPnet system. It interacts with the database to perform these operations.
purpose: To manage user-specific report filters by allowing updates and searches on report filters based on the user session details.

workflows.name: Update Report Filter
steps: Set the database procedure name to UserReportFilterUpdate.
Add parameters UserID, ReportName, FieldName, and FieldValue to the database session.

workflows.name: Search Report Filters
steps: Set the database procedure name to UserReportFiltersSearch.
Add parameters UserID and ReportName to the database session.
Execute the database query to get data.
Iterate through the data reader to read FieldName and FieldValue.
Add each FieldName and FieldValue to a dictionary.

system_behavior: The system updates or retrieves report filter details based on user session data.
